patthana23.31:1.1: Naparittārammaṇaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā parittārammaṇo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana23.31:2.1: Naparittārammaṇaṃ naakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā parittārammaṇo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cuddasa.
patthana23.31:3.1: Naparittārammaṇo naabyākato dhammo parittārammaṇassa abyākatassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. (Saṃkhittaṃ.)… Ārammaṇe ekavīsa.
